instruction: Candid lifestyle medium shot of a bright indoor living room. The young woman (R1) stands on the right, facing left with a joyful expression, receiving the envelope. A wooden table with a red floral pouch is in the foreground. Soft natural light illuminates the scene, highlighting the warm red tones.
